messages.text: Heads up: HELOC pricing sheet got updated this morning. Variable margin is up 25 bps on the 80-85% CLTV tier effective for applications taken starting today. Anything already locked is grandfathered.
Thanks Tammy. Do we know if that applies to pipeline files that haven't hit a rate lock yet? I've got {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0209}} sitting in processing with a HELOC request.
If there's no lock in LoanOrigination as of 9am today, it reprices. Check the lock status field on the file rather than going from memory of the quote.
Checked, no lock on that one. So I need to re-disclose and call them. Ugh, they were quoted last week at the old margin.
Does the change touch the 70% CLTV and below tier at all? Have two apps in that band and want to know whether I need to call anyone.
Looking at the sheet now, the lower tiers are unchanged. Only 80-85% moved up, plus the floor went from 4.50% to 4.75%.
Perfect, that's a relief. Nothing to do on mine then.
Question for underwriting: with the higher margin, DTI on a few of my higher-CLTV files gets tighter. Are we rerunning the debt service calc in CreditScoring or is the stated payment fine?
Rerun it. Qualifying payment should use the new fully-indexed rate, not the old quote. Stale numbers in the file will get flagged at QC.
Got it. I'll rerun everything in the 80-85% band this morning and note it in the file.
For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0194}}'s HELOC renewal, the new margin doesn't apply since it's a modification of an existing line, right? Want to confirm before I update the credit memo.
Correct, renewals on existing lines follow the original agreement terms. Just don't let the memo imply a repricing. Note the existing line on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00403}} stays as is.
Update: reached {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0209}}, they're fine with the new pricing but asked about locking today. Sending the revised disclosure and lock request now.
Good. Get the lock in before end of day and make sure the disclosure timestamp matches. Ping me if the system rejects the old margin code.
